why: Davis and Hillman's Jan 2025 arXiv preprint extends the Borel Conjecture for manifolds with boundary to a new case: compact aspherical 4-manifolds with elementary amenable fundamental groups, using topological surgery in dimension 4 and validity of Farrell-Jones for these groups; the general conjecture remains open.
